mentions.name: Adamant
mentions.description: A sandboxing tool built as a wrapper around Bubblewrap, with networking added via a socat proxy. It supports profiles to prepare and probe programs, runs commands with isolated ingress port forwarding (e.g. a sandboxed webserver reachable from outside), and can execute headless Firefox sessions that take screenshots from inside the sandbox.
mentions.problem: Running test harnesses directly on the author's machine is a bad idea, and Docker/Podman are too complicated for the task at hand.
mentions.source_excerpt: Decided that running harnesses directly on my machine is a bad idea. Docker/Podman are too complicated for the task at hand. So I built Adamant. It started out as a basic wrapper around Bubblewrap. Then I added networking via a socat proxy.
